en: We're the KANTO RIDER FEDERATION!\nVroom! Vavavavooom! Vroom!\pMy bike's wimpy, so I have to\nmake exhaust noises myself!
Hey, hey, lady!\nFork over some spending money!
Aiyeeh!\pWh-who are you?!\nI… I'll call the police!
Those BIKERS…\nAre they gone?\pOh, thank goodness!\nThey certainly had me terrified!
Those BIKERS ran off, and\nLOSTELLE was found safe.\pEverything turned out for the best!
